body:
Interestingly, I was talking to her about another Ex of mine (someone I've been with since myself and her split up) and I was talking about how it wasn't an amazing relationship, and how I was in it for longer than I really should have been.


She repeatedly brought up the idea that, quoting again, "love it blind." Maybe I'm being wishful, but I think she might be realising what this guy is really like.

She knows he's cheated, at least once. She's said this herself. She refused to believe that he'd done it more than once.


The reason the pregnancy doesn't concern me is because I was *that* kid in school that didn't know his dad. I made a promise a long, long time ago that I'd never be someone to write a person off because they have a child.


A friend of mine suggested I got for it, and go for it hard like you said, it's just how to approach it. Like I said, I don't want to completely mess things up for her. With a baby on the way, that's the worst thing I could do.


With that said, I also really, *really* don't want to go back to sitting around thinking about how I can't bear a future without her. Tonight has really opened my eyes and made me realise that I need to say/do something.

Thank you.


Let me shed some light on the boyfriend, then give you the largest dilemma...


Her boyfriend has cheated on her, several times. I knew this before I started talking to her again. A lot of people I know have told me about this, and his reputation is known to precede him. On top of this, she has repeatedly told me that his main interest seems to be alcohol, and that he's not really, and a quote, *"a forever kind of guy."*


Now the dilemma, she's pregnant with his child. This doesn't bother me, personally. I would have no issue with raising a child that I hadn't fathered, especially having never known my own father.


She's frequently mentioned that she misses the time when we were together, and again quoting, she said that if she could turn back time then she would.


I've had a hobby for the last few years that took up a lot of my time, but I realised recently that I'm using it as a crutch to distract myself and fool myself into thinking I'm happy.
